Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules

Class FindingFormatter

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules.FindingFormatter
public final class FindingFormatter extends Object
Utility class that builds consistently structured, business-friendly finding messages for the HTML audit dashboard.

Design goals

  • Every finding produced by any AuditRule looks the same to the dashboard — labelled fields, human-readable language, no raw exception class names.
  • Zero dependencies on any rule implementation; the class is stateless and package-private-friendly via its static factory methods.
  • No changes to RuleResult — findings are still plain Strings; this class simply standardises how those strings are composed before they are passed to RuleResult.fail(com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules.AuditRule, long, java.util.List<java.lang.String>) or RuleResult.error(com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules.AuditRule, long, java.lang.Throwable).

Usage — one call per finding


 // Link check
 String f = FindingFormatter.linkFinding()
         .title("View Online Link")
         .displayText("View Online")
         .href("https://company.com/view")
         .failed("HTTP 404 Not Found")
         .build();

 // Broken anchor
 String f = FindingFormatter.brokenAnchor("Shop Now", "https://brand.com/shop", "HTTP 404 Not Found");

 // Privacy / unsubscribe link absent
 String f = FindingFormatter.missingPrivacyLink("unsubscribe");

 // CTA issue
 String f = FindingFormatter.ctaFinding("<a>", "Shop Now", "CTA link has no href");

 // Generic rule finding
 String f = FindingFormatter.generic("MISSING_ALT", "3 image(s) are missing alt text");

Thread safety

All methods are stateless and safe for concurrent use.

      public static String structuredFinding(String title, String element, String detail)
      Generic finding with a structured detail block but without link or CTA context; useful for image, accessibility, or content rules.

      Example output: 

       Font Size Violation
   Element         : <td style="font-size:9px">
   Detail          : Font size 9px is below the recommended minimum of 13px
      Parameters:

      element - CSS selector, tag, or other element descriptor
      detail - explanation of the issue
      Returns:
      formatted finding string

    • altTextFinding

      public static String altTextFinding(String imageRef, boolean passed, String reason)
      Finding for a single image's alt-text validation outcome — PASS or FAIL.

      Example PASS output: 

       Alt Text Validation
   Image           : hero-banner.png
   Validation      : PASSED
   Reason          : Alt text is present.

      Example FAIL output: 

       Alt Text Validation
   Image           : hero-banner.png
   Validation      : FAILED
   Reason          : Missing alt attribute.
      Parameters:
      imageRef - a human-identifiable reference to the image — typically its src attribute (may be blank/null; falls back to "(no src attribute)")
      passed - true for a PASSED outcome, false for FAILED
      reason - business-readable explanation of the outcome
      Returns:
      formatted finding string

    • viewOnlineFinding

      public static String viewOnlineFinding(String displayText, String href, boolean passed, String reason)
      Finding for a "View Online" / browser-version link's validation outcome — PASS or FAIL. Reuses FindingFormatter.LinkFindingBuilder; when href or displayText are blank/null (e.g. the link could not be located on the page at all), those lines are simply omitted from the output.

      Example PASS output: 

       View Online Link
   Displayed Text  : View Online
   Destination     : https://company.com/view
   Validation      : PASSED
   Reason          : Link resolved successfully.

      Example FAIL output: 

       View Online Link
   Displayed Text  : View Online
   Destination     : https://company.com/view
   Validation      : FAILED
   Reason          : HTTP 404 Not Found
      Parameters:
      displayText - visible anchor text (may be blank/null)
      href - the link's destination URL (may be blank/null)
      passed - true for a PASSED outcome, false for FAILED
      reason - business-readable explanation of the outcome
      Returns:
      formatted finding string

    • disclaimerFinding

      public static String disclaimerFinding(boolean passed, String reason)
      Finding for a disclaimer / reply-to validation outcome — PASS or FAIL. Reuses FindingFormatter.LinkFindingBuilder with no display text or destination set, since a disclaimer check has no associated link to cite — only a pass/fail outcome and a reason.

      Example PASS output: 

       Disclaimer Validation
   Validation      : PASSED
   Reason          : Required disclaimer text is present.

      Example FAIL output: 

       Disclaimer Validation
   Validation      : FAILED
   Reason          : Mandatory legal disclaimer not found.
      Parameters:
      passed - true for a PASSED outcome, false for FAILED
      reason - business-readable explanation of the outcome
      Returns:
      formatted finding string
